name: AlignBench
intro: AlignBench是一个多维度中文大语言模型对齐评测基准。它采用人机协同的数据构建流程，包含683个源于真实场景的查询，并为知识密集型问题提供了可靠的网络证据。该基准利用结合思维链的规则校准多维LLM评审机制进行自动化评估，以确保结果的高可靠性和可解释性。
build_method: 真实场景查询筛选, GPT-4参考答案草拟, 人工证据核验, 难度过滤
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 对话
build_method_en: Real-scenario query filtering, GPT-4 reference drafting, human evidence verification, difficulty filtering
intro_en: AlignBench is a multidimensional Chinese large language model alignment benchmark. It uses a human-AI collaborative data construction process, containing 683 queries derived from real-world scenarios, and provides reliable web evidence for knowledge-intensive questions. The benchmark employs an automated evaluation mechanism combining chain-of-thought reasoning with rule-based calibration for multidimensional LLM review, ensuring high reliability and interpretability of results.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.18743v4 §2.1, §2.2, and §3, especially Tables 2, 3, and 7. The diagram preserves the paper's eight category names; online-chat and researcher-written sources; four query rules; GPT-4 reference drafting; human revision with web-search URLs and quotations for knowledge-intensive items; GPT-3.5-Turbo, ChatGLM, and Sparkdesk difficulty filtering; GPT-4 removal of the easiest 50%; the final 683 queries; and task-specific multidimensional point-wise judging on calibrated 1–10 rules with the human reference anchored at 8.
